candidates.change_summary: Replace the safe addition of msg.value into balances[msg.sender] with an unchecked addition to allow overflow, potentially changing balances at arbitrary keys after Deposit.
Remove the balance update so Deposit no longer increases balances, which changes balances(k) after Deposit for affected keys.
Update a different mapping key (tx.origin) instead of msg.sender when crediting the deposit, changing balances for keys the checker might pick.
Credit the deposit to an arbitrary fixed address instead of msg.sender, altering balances at that key after Deposit.
Subtract msg.value from balances[msg.sender] instead of adding, which will change balances for some keys after Deposit.
Insert an additional increment of balances[msg.sender] so Deposit double-credits the sender, changing balances after Deposit.
Move the call to Log.AddMessage to before the balance update, which could change observable state order and allow reentrancy to affect balances at some key.
